evidence_facts.fact: Walkway runs from 고투몰 exit G2 (at the 래미안 원베일리 shopping-area public open space) through the corridor to 반포한강공원. Order from G2: 24 Hours mural (first), tourist center near the middle, Picasso mural (about 65 m), then 반포나들목 underpass to the park. Lengths given: 350 m (서초구 via Herald 2025), 360 m (삼성물산/서울시 2024), mural street 425 m and about 500 m including the plaza (서울신문 2024), 'about 500 m' (서울시 mediahub). Reconcile as about 360 m of corridor, about 500 m end to end.
evidence_facts.where: G2 exit of 고투몰, then toward 반포한강공원; Picasso section is the end nearest the park, per the Wonder Street article (visitors start at G2, pass the 24h mural, then reach the sculptures)

evidence_facts.fact: Made by a 기부채납 from the 래미안 원베일리 complex (삼성물산); the 350 m '서울의 24시간' mural came from that donation. Won iF, Red Dot and IDEA 2024 (Environments, Featured Finalist) design awards. Opening date not found; the tourist center opened 2024-07-10 and murals were in place by July 2024. Seocho-gu held a nickname contest for the walkway in Sept-Oct 2025 (until 10/9, results 10/15); result not found.

'서울 시민의 일상, 서울의 24시간': 24 domestic and international graffiti, cartoon and illustration artists, each painting about 15 m (24 x 15 m = 360 m), arranged by time of day. Each panel has a digital-clock style time label (01:00, 02:00, 06:00, 12:00, 14:00, 20:00 seen) with the artist name. Navy and blue wall base; panels show Gyeongbokgung with fireworks, food, Hangang picnic, families. Selfie-spot panel: '수고한 우리의 새 자장가' by Bojan Jelesovski.

Spain Tourism Office 'Picasso Urban Art Mural' series (4th city after Shanghai 2021, Bern 2022, Munich 2023), with the Málaga tourism office. Painted by Eduardo Luque (Raron). 65 m long; blue/orange cubist eyes, a grayscale Picasso in a striped shirt holding a wine glass, a flamenco figure with a spread skirt echoing 부채춤, 'MÁLAGA LOVES SEOUL' lettering, 'I AM PICASSO' text. The structural columns in this section are also painted blue with murals/text and run in a row down the hall. The Seoul article lists a 160 m figure for this mural, but other sources say 65 m.
evidence_facts.round17_correction: Historical cubist mural description retained as source history; reviewed current frames show tall framed panels in this stretch. Default scene now reflects those panels.

evidence_facts.topic: Wonder Street sculptures and ceiling installation (2026)
evidence_facts.fact: 서초구 and 서초문화재단 second edition 2026-04-27 to 2026-11-15, tied to Crown Haitai's 견생조각전. 11 artists, 12 sculptures (animals, characters, nature) lined along the 65 m Picasso mural street; ceiling installation '도란도란' (colorful hanging discs/balloon-like pieces on the ceiling) and floor pattern sheets (colored blobs) based on the artists' works. 2026 photos show an orange hooded figure, blue figures, a yellow banana boat with white figures, a red astronaut, a white deer, a green propeller aircraft and a metal lizard. Individual artist names and exact positions not found. Previous year about 30,000 visitors. Ends 11/15, so the temporary pieces may be gone soon.

고터·세빛 관광안내센터 opened 2024-07-10 in the middle of the walkway (Seocho-gu, Seoul Tourism Foundation, Seoul Tourist Association). Open 11:00-20:00 year-round; English, Japanese, Chinese interpreters; foreign-coin-to-won exchange kiosk (WOWPASS machine visible); brochure shelves and a digital information kiosk; glass-front white storefront. The Wonder Street article places a 관광특구 lounge at the far end of the walkway. Seocho-gu is considering a café-style rest area in unused space. Chairs and tables exist for rest according to the citizen-reporter write-up (not independently confirmed).

evidence_facts.topic: Daylight, sunken garden, look of the corridor
evidence_facts.fact: Natural light comes through a sunken garden (썬큰 가든) and an upper skylight. One photo shows a sunken bamboo planter courtyard in the corridor. The hall is wide with white-gray floor tiles and a yellow tactile guide line, a dark gray/white ceiling with exposed red fire pipes and long fluorescent strips, and paired painted column rows. Signage hangs from the ceiling ('고터·세빛 관광안내센터 및 피카소 벽화 가는 길'). Fire hydrant boxes sit in the mural walls.
evidence_facts.round17_correction: 2025+ walk frames show ONE blue-column row near east wall, not paired rows; this supersedes earlier paired-row interpretation.

evidence_facts.fact: Installation artist Vakki (빠키) showed '기하학의 리듬' at the 공개공지 in front of G2, opened 2024-07-15. Temporary exhibit, current status unknown.

evidence_facts.topic: Park-side end: 반포나들목 underpass and signs
evidence_facts.fact: Near the park the route passes the 반포나들목 underpass: white tile walls with a yellow floor guide line and orange stripe, and a Han River mural (river, a boat with a red umbrella, skyline). Signposts: '고투몰 / 관광안내센터 / 반포한강공원 BANPO HANGANG PARK' (orange/blue pillar), and a '반포나들목 주변지역 안내도' map board. Related Seocho 'Urban Canvas' tile-wall art near subway exit 5 (themed 'everyone is the main character'). Seocho-gu's 2026-01 Urban Canvas project upgraded the Jamsugyo underground crosswalk with a media gate, background music, dichroic film and brighter lighting (96% satisfaction) and describes an art route from the 원베일리 wall paintings through the Picasso mural to the park. Not directly part of the straight walkway.

Seoul plans an elevator at the south end of 반포대교, full pedestrian use of 잠수교 (target April 2026) and a new square-shaped crosswalk at the 고속터미널 intersection in December 2025 (previously pedestrians could cross only via the underground passage).

No official floor plan, entrance/elevator positions, opening hours of the corridor itself, or exact turn geometry was found in readable text. The Seocho 고터세빛 관광특구 안내지도 (data.go.kr dataset 15157853, JPG, 2026-03-27) is the best official map source and should be downloaded from the portal by hand. 24-hour access was not confirmed. Also not found: any 2025-26 Naver blog photos, as blog fetching was not attempted and search surfaced none.
